questions.title: Which leader will the Kremlin announce as Vladimir Putin’s counterpart for bilateral talks on the Ukraine war at the 2026 SCO summit?
questions.background: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) holds an annual leaders’ summit, which also provides opportunities for bilateral diplomatic meetings.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Kremlin statements or reliable news reporting quoting a Kremlin official, published by August 31, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the leader publicly identified as scheduled to meet Vladimir Putin bilaterally on the sidelines of the 2026 SCO summit to discuss the Ukraine war. The announced meeting schedule determines the answer; the meeting need not have taken place.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The leader’s full name.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
questions.background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the city.

questions.title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
questions.background: Goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and his partner were attacked during a burglary at their Paris home in July 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The defendant's name as publicly reported.
questions.accepted_format: The defendant's name as publicly reported.

questions.title: Which country will Washington propose as a possible venue for renewed trilateral Russia–Ukraine ceasefire talks by September 25, 2026?
questions.background: The United States has been involved in efforts to broker an end to the Russia–Ukraine war.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country publicly identified by Ukraine's president as Washington's proposed location for renewed talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine, using the proposal current as of September 25, 2026. A suggested location is sufficient; the talks need not have taken place.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-25
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Which party will receive the largest share of the vote in Berlin's 2026 state election?
questions.background: Berlin is both a city and a German federal state. Its state election determines the composition of its parliament.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results published by Berlin's election authority or reliable contemporaneous reporting of those results.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the party receiving the highest statewide vote share in Berlin's 2026 state election. Subsequent coalition negotiations and the selection of the mayor do not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The party's name or its standard abbreviation.
questions.accepted_format: The party's name or its standard abbreviation.

questions.title: Who will be the first person charged in the United Kingdom over alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
questions.background: British authorities have been investigating allegations involving Rwandan genocide suspects living in the United Kingdom.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official public charging announcement from the United Kingdom’s Crown Prosecution Service.
  • Resolution: Identify the first individual formally charged in the United Kingdom in connection with alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, provided the charges are announced by December 31, 2026. Arrests without charges, extradition proceedings, and charges brought outside the United Kingdom do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.
questions.accepted_format: The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.

questions.title: Which former minister from Viktor Orban's government, if any, will have parliamentary immunity lifted in September 2026 to permit an embezzlement investigation?
questions.background: The party that won Hungary's 2026 parliamentary election campaigned on tackling corruption. Parliamentary immunity can prevent prosecutors from pursuing criminal investigations against legislators unless Parliament lifts it.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Hungarian parliamentary records or contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations identifying former ministers whose immunity is lifted.
  • Qualifying Event: Hungary's Parliament must vote during September 2026 to remove a former Orban-government minister's immunity specifically to allow prosecutors to pursue an embezzlement investigation. Allegations alone, without the parliamentary vote, do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the former minister's full name. If no former minister qualifies during September 2026, resolve as no qualifying minister.
questions.accepted_format: Provide the former minister's full name. If no former minister qualifies during September 2026, resolve as no qualifying minister.

questions.title: Which city or region will the DOSB choose in 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics?
questions.background: The DOSB is Germany's national Olympic committee. Its domestic candidate selection is separate from the International Olympic Committee's eventual decision on which country will host the Games.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The DOSB's official selection announcement, as confirmed by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the city or region officially selected during 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics. This concerns Germany's domestic candidate selection, not the eventual international host selection.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the selected city or region.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the selected city or region.
